card.title: 61st KIRKENES
card.flavorText: The 61st Kirkenes Regiment belonged to the 45th Rifle Division, which was originally raised during the Russian Civil War and fought extensively throughout WWII. After being destroyed in the Battle of Stalingrad, the division was reformed in May 1943 from the 67th Naval Rifle Brigade. It then joined the Karelian Front and operated in the Arctic regions near the Soviet-Finnish border. The 45th Rifle Division played a key role in the Petsamo-Kirkenes Offensive in October 1944, a Soviet campaign aimed at expelling German forces from northern Finland and northeastern Norway. Fighting in extreme Arctic conditions, the division advanced through rugged terrain and poor weather, helping capture the strategic Norwegian town of Kirkenes. This marked the first major Soviet operation on Norwegian soil and contributed to the collapse of the German defensive line in Lapland. For its role in this campaign, the division received the honorific title "Pechenga" after capturing that key area. It remained active until the end of the war, guarding the soviet northern frontier. The division’s operations demonstrated the Red Army’s ability to wage high-tempo offensives even in harsh and remote environments.
